correctness.rationale: The exact velocity-jump generator gives corrected quadratic and quartic superharmonic functions, proving finite second moments when D_eff<1/3. The cited mean solution supplies u~x²/[2(1-D_eff)]. The n=2 averaged backward ODE has integrating factor x^(-1/D_eff), yielding an eventually negative derivative when 1/3<=D_eff<1, a contradiction to nonnegative finite second moments. The quartic coefficient follows by eliminating the forbidden homogeneous growth. The initial protected interval has an exponential hitting tail. Exact symbolic identities and finite-domain Poisson problems independently corroborate but do not replace proof.
